description: Implementation of the HpackVarintDecoder class for decoding variable-length integers in HTTP/2 HPACK header compression.

classes.name: HpackVarintDecoder
classes.description: Decoder class for variable-length integers used in HPACK header compression.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes decoding with a prefix value and length, resumes decoding process.

methods.name: StartExtended
methods.description: Starts decoding in extended mode with specified prefix length.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the decoder's current state.

methods.name: StartExtendedForTest
methods.description: Test helper to start extended decoding.
